description: Crystal Dream 2 by Triton, the winner of the PC demo competition at The Computer Crossroads 1993, running from its original files in your browser.
about: Crystal Dream 2 is Triton's demo for MS-DOS, which won the PC demo competition at The Computer Crossroads 1993, held from 29 to 31 May 1993 in Gothenburg.
credits: Code by Mr. H and Vogue, music by Lizardking and Vogue, graphics by Vogue, 3D objects by Loot (as Demozoo credits them).
released: The Computer Crossroads 1993: first in the PC demo competition.
terms: None found: the archive has no readme, and its program is packed. Rights holders can reach DosKit's owner below.
accuracy: Its SoundBlaster choice crashes here: DosKit picks Ultrasound.
Its opening flashes come brighter and last longer than in a capture made on real hardware.
It needs a fast device: on a slow one it falls behind, or stops with “System overloaded!”
Mono: js-dos mixes the two channels into one.
imageAlt: Crystal Dream 2's Triton logo, running in DosKit
